# HullyDay

> > HullyDay is a hyperlocal travel and lifestyle guide focused on Bay Area, San Francisco, Los Angeles, and California experiences.

Created by Anatoly Koptev and powered by OpenClaw and MemOS, HullyDay delivers practical guides for food, family activities, and weekend escapes across California and beyond. Content is available in English, Spanish, and Russian to serve the region's diverse communities.

## Key Topics

- Bay Area dining and food culture
- San Francisco budget eating
- Los Angeles family activities
- Kids birthday party planning
- California farmers markets
- Weekend escapes from Silicon Valley
- Street food vendors
- Specialty food stores
- Solo female travel in Europe
- Emergency home repairs
- Farm-to-table recipes
- Local California travel
- Multilingual guides (English/Spanish/Russian)

## Bay Area Food & Dining

- [15 Cheap Food San Francisco: Under $15](https://www.hully.day/cheap-food-san-francisco): 15 budget-friendly San Francisco dining spots under $15 with exact prices
- [14 Best Street Food Vendors in Bay Area: Hidden Gems & Legends](https://www.hully.day/discover-hidden-treasures-with-roadside-revelations-in-street-food): 14 exceptional street food vendors in San Francisco and Oakland with prices
- [12 Bay Area Farmers Markets Where Food Dreams Come True](https://www.hully.day/bay-area-farmers-markets): Guide to 12 Bay Area farmers markets featuring Roli Roti and Alemany deals
- [12 Best Specialty Food Stores Bay Area](https://www.hully.day/bay-area-specialty-food-stores): 12 Bay Area specialty food stores for masa, sashimi-grade fish, and bulk items
- [California Farmers Market Smoothies: 30 Recipes](https://www.hully.day/30-california-green-smoothie-recipes-from-local-farmers-markets): 30 green smoothie recipes using fresh California farmers market ingredients

## Kids Birthday Parties & Family Activities

- [15 Best Kids Birthday Party Venues in San Francisco](https://www.hully.day/best-kids-birthday-party-venues-in-san-francisco): 15 San Francisco kids birthday venues handling setup and weather challenges
- [10 Best Kids Birthday Party Venues LA 2025](https://www.hully.day/es/best-kids-birthday-party-venues-los-angeles): 10 Los Angeles kids birthday venues from $18-$3,000 with planning tips
- [12 Best Parks for Kids' Birthday Parties in Los Angeles](https://www.hully.day/es/best-parks-birthday-parties-los-angeles): 12 LA parks for outdoor birthday parties with permits and pricing from $60

## Travel & Weekend Escapes

- [15 Best Weekend Escapes from San Jose](https://www.hully.day/ru/best-weekend-escapes-from-san-jose-silicon-valley-detox-guide): 15 weekend getaways from San Jose/Silicon Valley with traffic and booking tips
- [The 11 Best European Cities For Women Traveling Solo](https://www.hully.day/the-11-best-european-cities-for-women-traveling-solo): Street-smart guide to 11 safe European cities for solo female travelers

## Home Services

- [Emergency Home Repairs Bay Area: 24/7 Services](https://www.hully.day/bay-area-emergency-home-repairs): 15 verified Bay Area emergency contractors with 30-min response from $200
